dialogues.speaker: Iridescent Legacy: Part II
dialogues.text: ...These are the words of the sovereign ruler Aj Chojojik Kamikabal U'uk...

dialogues.speaker: Iridescent Legacy: Part II
dialogues.text: ...Ah, such a frightful foe these humans are. So weak as to be unable to withstand a single blow, and yet even as their skin sloughs off their corroding corpses, more of their kin rise up to take their places...

dialogues.speaker: Iridescent Legacy: Part II
dialogues.text: ...Do they feel no fear? Do they not tremble in the face of death? Does not pain afflict them? Nor despair consume their hearts?

dialogues.speaker: Iridescent Legacy: Part II
dialogues.text: ...Ah, my lungs are pierced, to breathe is agony... Hehe, these humans who would end me, did the bright light that fills their eyes once shine from ours?

dialogues.speaker: Iridescent Legacy: Part II
dialogues.text: ...Hah, indeed? My lord, that was a time when we had yet to abandon our glory...
